hints.title: Condensed Key Grouping Logic
hints.text: Words sharing the first letter, omitted character count, and last letter map to identical signature keys.

hints.title: Set Membership Verification Under Shared Abbreviation
hints.text: An abbreviation is unique for a word if no word in the dictionary produces this abbreviation, or if every dictionary word producing it is identical to the queried word.

hints.title: Signature Lookup Blueprint
hints.text: Compute signature: if len <= 2 return word, else word[0] + str(len - 2) + word[-1]. Store dictionary words grouped by signature in a map of sets. Return True if signature not present or set contains only the queried word.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Initial construction processes all strings in O(N * L); isUnique runs in O(L) signature hashing time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rechecking every dictionary word during each query runs in O(N * L) and degrades performance.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping dictionary words by signature accelerates queries to constant average lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct handling of duplicates in dictionary and words of length 2 or fewer.
